subproblem.title: Besicovitch–Federer for compact purely unrectifiable sets of finite measure, given Eilenberg's inequality (Dall'Alba, proof of Thm 5.1)
subproblem.statement: Assume Eilenberg's inequality in the exact frozen form of the root-level node eilenberg_upper_integral_inequality (as in the sibling infinite_fibres). Then for all n ≥ 1, ℓ ≥ 1 and every compact, purely n-unrectifiable A ⊆ ℝ^{n+ℓ} with Hⁿ(A) < ∞: for Lebesgue-a.e. v ∈ (ℝ^{n+ℓ})ⁿ, if v is linearly independent then Hⁿ(frameProjection v(A)) = 0, i.e. ForAlmostAllProjections (n+ℓ) n (fun p ↦ Hⁿ(p(A)) = 0).
subproblem.lean_statement: (∀ (N m k : ℕ), ∃ C : ℝ≥0, ∀ (A : Set (Rn N)) (f : Rn N → Rn m) (L : ℝ≥0), LipschitzWith L f → ∃ g : Rn m → ℝ≥0∞, Measurable g ∧ (∀ y, μHE[k] (A ∩ f ⁻¹' {y}) ≤ g y) ∧ ∫⁻ y, g y ≤ ((C * L ^ m : ℝ≥0) : ℝ≥0∞) * μHE[m + k] A) → ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ), 0 < n → 0 < ℓ → ∀ A : Set (Rn (n + ℓ)), IsCompact A → PurelyUnrectifiable n A → μHE[n] A < ∞ → ForAlmostAllProjections (n + ℓ) n (fun p ↦ μHE[n] (p '' A) = 0)
proof_key_steps: Apply cone_trichotomy for δ_i = 1/(i+1) and intersect the countably many full-measure sets of frames.
For a fixed good independent frame v, P := frameProjection v = (span v).starProjection with finrank n, and P is 1-Lipschitz.

Exceptional sets: zero density (cone_density_positive, Hⁿ-null), infinite density (cone_density_infinite, null projection), infinite fibres (infinite_fibres with Eilenberg, null projection), trichotomy failure (null).
A point outside all of them has points of A ∖ {a} in a + V arbitrarily close to a, so its fibre is infinite.
Hence P(A) is covered by countably many Hⁿ-null sets.

audit.reason: All four dependencies apply with their stated hypotheses. Intersecting the full-measure frame sets over 1/(i+1), the remaining axis witnesses force an infinite fibre. The resulting cover has null projection. The exact conditional Lean conclusion was independently checked by replaying the assembly with the proposed child types.
